title: Peripheral-context boundary test with chain supervision as a prior-art control
description: Reframe the experiment so that chain/shortest-path supervision is an explicit prior-art control, not a claimed contribution (path-based reasoning over KG subgraphs is established: MHGRN unifies path-based reasoning, Variational Reasoning trains over latent KG paths). The inferential target becomes the residual: under a matched supervision token budget, identical templates, and identical test-time context, does chain + same-passage peripheral triples beat (a) chain-only supervision and (b) a chain + shuffled/unrelated-triple arm of equal length? Report Hits@1 by hop depth and a one-hop failure rate. The repair loop and RL stage are dropped from the primary contribution.
why_differs: Unlike MHGRN/Variational Reasoning (which establish path-based reasoning without a peripheral-context arm) and unlike the inference-time context systems (SG-RAG MOT, CLAUSE, Co-E), this isolates the training-time effect of peripheral context against a matched shuffled-context control with the chain credited to prior art; no retrieved work performs that contrast.
technical_mechanism: Construct four supervision views over the same targets (isolated triple/path; full reasoning chain; chain + same-passage peripheral triples; chain + shuffled unrelated triples) at matched token budget and with byte-identical instruction/output templates, fine-tune the same base model, and evaluate all arms under identical inference context, reporting per-hop Hits@1, one-hop failure rate, and a transfer gap.
expected_benefit: Makes the surviving claim falsifiable and honest: chain supervision is credited to prior work, and the paper's result is either a measured (likely small) peripheral-context effect or a clean boundary/negative finding. The shuffled-context arm at matched budget directly tests the strongest counter-evidence (the +0.003 F1 inference-time result) on the training side, where it has not been tested.
potential_novelty: Hedged and deliberately narrow: no retrieved work runs this matched-budget, inference-context-matched training ablation, so the comparison and the shuffled-context control are unoccupied. Because the chain component is prior art, novelty rests only on the peripheral-context boundary result and the hop-depth/one-hop-failure diagnostic, not on a new mechanism.
implementation_difficulty_basis: Reuses existing datasets (MetaQA/WebQSP/CWQ), an off-the-shelf 7B instruction model with LoRA, and existing KG/path construction; no new architecture and no RL infrastructure once the RL stage is dropped.
experimental_difficulty_basis: Four matched-budget arms, byte-identical templates, multiple seeds, a hop-depth split with a construction check, and a format-controlled scorer; standard but careful, and the expected result in the peripheral arm may be null.
main_risk: If both the peripheral and shuffled arms are null, the result is purely negative; it must be pre-registered and framed as a boundary contribution, and a null chain effect would collapse the remaining premise entirely.
required_baselines: Chain + shuffled/unrelated triples at matched token budget
Training-free inference-time context baseline at matched budget
